message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.need_player: This command needs a player to act on. Run it in game, or as a player with /execute as <player> run dungeon ...
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.no_dim: The Mega-Dungeon dimension is not loaded on this server.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.not_in_dunge: You are not on a floor of the Mega-Dungeon (you are in %1$s).
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.no_sector: You are in the Mega-Dungeon but on no floor (a gap between two sectors). Walk onto a floor first.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.failed: That did not work: %1$s. The server log has the details.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.range: Floor %1$s is out of range. Use -1000 to +1000 (0 is the Sanctuary Hub).
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.ok_boss: This is a boss floor: the Guardian waits at the end of it.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.ok_band: Floor %1$s lies inside a ten-floor sector (floors %2$s to %3$s): you stand at the sector's landing.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.hub: Teleported to Floor 0, the Sanctuary Hub.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.hub_none: Floor 0 cannot be reached: the Sanctuary dimension is not loaded.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.queued: Floor %1$s is not built yet. %2$s floor(s) are queued (about %3$s seconds); you are teleported the moment it stands. Use /dungeon tp again to replace the request.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.progress: Building the way to floor %1$s: %2$s%% (%3$s floor(s) to go)
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.replaced: The earlier teleport request to floor %1$s is dropped.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.locked: The Directional Lock closes the %1$s to you. Free yourself first: /multiverse mega floors unlock <you> (or floors set <you> <road>), or turn floors.opsBypass on.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.no_party: The dungeon has no free lane for your party. Raise party.maxParties.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.off: Floor %1$s does not exist yet and the dungeon cannot grow: mega.expansion is switched off.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.limit: The dungeon reached its limit of %1$s sectors (mega.maxSectors) before floor %2$s. Raise the limit in the server config.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.failed_ge: A floor on the way failed to generate (sector %1$s). Retry it with /multiverse mega regen %1$s, then run the teleport again.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.stuck: The dungeon has not moved for %1$s seconds, so the teleport to floor %2$s is cancelled. Check /multiverse mega status.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.refused: The generator refused the next floor: %1$s
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.tp.no_pad: Sector %1$s has no landing to stand on (its data is incomplete). See the server log.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skip.hub_bac: You are on Floor 0: there is nothing behind it. Skip forward, or use /dungeon tp.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skip.go: Skipping %1$s floor(s) %2$s from floor %3$s, to floor %4$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skip.capped: The skip was cut short: the road ends at floor %1$s (+-1000), and going back stops at Floor 0.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.boss.level: Dungeon level %1$s does not exist. Use -100 to -1 (Abyssal road) or 1 to 100 (Holy road); 0 is the Hub.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.boss.spawn_o: The boss of level %1$s (floor %2$s) appears at %3$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.boss.spawn_f: No boss could be spawned for level %1$s here.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.boss.kill_ok: Slew %1$s boss(es) near you. A Mana Core drops for the Gatekeeper.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.boss.kill_no: There is no boss within reach to slay.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.rift.fail: No rift could be opened at %1$s: the place is not free, or a shortcut needs a floor of the Mega-Dungeon under you.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skill.unknow: There is no Unique skill '%1$s'. Tab-complete the id, or use 'all'.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skill.busy: A skill grant or reset is still running for you. Wait for its summary.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skill.all_st: Teaching %1$s Unique skills over the next few ticks...
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.skill.all_do: Done: %1$s Unique skill(s) learned, %2$s already known, %3$s failed, of %4$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.sp.removed: Skill Points were removed in 1.96.0 (skill books teach Unique skills directly); mastery now opens the later arts of a skill.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.sp.ok: Added %1$s mastery point(s) to each of your %2$s Unique skill(s) instead.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.sp.none: Skill Points were removed in 1.96.0 (skill books teach Unique skills directly); nothing granted, because you know no Unique skill yet. Use /dungeon skill unlock first.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.reset.alignm: Alignment cleared: no road, no lock, no record of the deepest floors, and the tracker forgot your floor.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.reset.waypoi: Waypoint cleared, with the memory of the deepest Landing: the next entry starts at the first floor.
You had no waypoint and no deepest-Landing memory; nothing to clear.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.reset.skills: Forgetting your %1$s Unique skill(s) over the next few ticks...
You know no Unique skill from the skill books; nothing to forget.
Done: %1$s Unique skill(s) forgotten, %2$s could not be taken away.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.reset.all: Everything of the dungeon is cleared for you: alignment, waypoint and Unique skills.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.on: WFC debug ON for %1$s minutes (or until you leave the dimension). Green = on a loop, yellow = single link, red = dead end. Run it again to stop.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.auto_t: WFC debug switched itself off: the %1$s minutes are over.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.auto_d: WFC debug switched itself off: you left the dimension.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.no_flo: WFC debug needs a built floor of the Mega-Dungeon under you.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.summar: Floor %1$s (sector %2$s): %3$s rooms, %4$s doorways, dead ends %5$s, loops %6$s, rooms on a loop %7$s, single-link rooms %8$s, separate parts %9$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.verdic: OK: no dead ends, one connected floor.
PROBLEM: %1$s dead end(s) and %2$s separate part(s); the red rooms and lines show where.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.info_m: Sector %1$s on the %2$s road, party %3$s, state %4$s, %5$s rooms%6$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.info_h: Floor 0, the Sanctuary Hub: no level, no theme, no seed of its own.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.debug.info_w: You are outside the dungeon. Your waypoint: %1$s.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.head: Dungeon admin commands (permission level 2). They act on you; use /execute as <player> run dungeon ... for someone else:
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.tp: Teleport to a floor (-1000 to +1000, 0 is the Hub); a floor not built yet is queued and you go the moment it stands.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.skip: Go forward one floor along your road (a negative number goes back towards the Hub).
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.skip_n: Go forward that many floors (-1000 to 1000).
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.boss_sp: Spawn the Decennial boss of a dungeon level (-100 to -1, 1 to 100) where you stand.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.boss_ki: Slay the boss near you; its Mana Core drops to test the Gatekeeper.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.rift_po: Open a pocket-dungeon rift at your crosshair.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.rift_sh: Open a floor-shortcut rift at your crosshair.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.skill_u: Learn a Unique skill (tab-complete the id) or 'all' of them.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.skill_s: Skill Points no longer exist: adds mastery points to your Unique skills instead.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.reset_a: Forget your road, the lock and the deepest floors.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.reset_s: Forget the Unique skills the skill books taught.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.reset_w: Forget your waypoint and the deepest Landing.
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.debug_w: Toggle the particle view of this floor's room graph (green loop, yellow single link, red dead end).
message.nusmp.dungeon.admin.help.debug_i: Say the floor, level, theme and seed you are standing in.
